highlights.title: A gift list you can tick off by hand
highlights.body: The printed gift list is now one compact table with a box for each thank-you written and mailed, amounts lined up, and page numbers. Choose the sort, whether to show addresses, group by type, or print only the thank-yous still to write.

highlights.title: Find any answer fast in the new Guide
highlights.body: Search the whole Guide, browse by section, and follow short numbered steps. On a phone it opens full screen and the back button takes you up one level.

highlights.title: See your whole weekend on the Overview
highlights.body: The Overview opens with your countdown, the Hebrew date, and every time and venue for the weekend. Copy the schedule to send to family.
